- **Gray Mold**: Large irregular tan/brown necrotic areas - not matching.

The distinct concentric rings (bullseye/target spot) are the hallmark diagnostic feature of Early Blight (Alternaria solani). The dark brown color, yellow halo, and leaf location all confirm this.
